name: Testimonial Swipe
description: Paired stories and portraits in a fanned deck with swipe navigation and timed progress.

settings.label: Story headings
settings.description: Entries pair by position. The quotation list sets the number of stories; missing companion entries use the matching example.

settings.label: Quotations
default: There is more room for the work when the next step is clear.
The best change was a quieter Monday. Everyone already knew where to begin.
Our ideas stayed ambitious. Getting them into the world became much simpler.
There is a little more care in every handoff, and you can see it in the result.
We spend less time finding the next step and more time making it count.
